summary: Installed view runtime digests bind source identity and root reads recheck the namespace

replay.detail: No automatic scan, startup/read rebuild, source replay or read migration. Existing explicit bounded Installer jobs remain owner-initiated.

schema.detail: No additional tables, triggers or shared schema change.

rules.detail: Source admission, authority, canonical order and checkpoint rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Namespace-mode ViewRuntime digests include the declared installed source and binding layout; all-legacy runtime digests remain byte-identical.

downtime.detail: No production activation, deployment or restart is included.

manual.detail: No new operator command or production adapter. Existing bridge signatures are unchanged.

recovery.detail: Library recovery documentation clarifies that explicit publication does not clear source-owner raw gap evidence, stale certificates return errors, and epoch changes or restore require a separate binding lifecycle.
